dedupe_keys.name: dataset 21 uav ray tracing simulations with 5 towers at lake wheeler

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This collection contains Sionna ray-tracing signal simulations for five Lake Wheeler towers and a UAV transmitter. It pairs simulated received signal strength with measurements from the AERPAW rural campaign listed as Dataset 12. UAV GPS trajectories and dual-channel USRP B210 receiver settings support matched comparisons. The source describes MATLAB plots for simulation-versus-measurement assessment, with applications to wireless coverage planning and network management. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Ray-tracing calibration and wireless coverage planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
